name: Tooltip
description: A short, non-interactive hint for one control: after a short mouse hover, or at once on keyboard focus, below the control (flipped when there's no room); it closes on leave, blur, Escape or a press, and never takes focus.
usage: Use for a name or a short read about one control: an icon button's name, the stages behind a stage strip
Use instead of the title attribute, which never shows on touch or keyboard focus
Wrap one focusable element; Tooltip keeps its ref and handlers and adds aria-describedby while open

Pass toggle when the trigger is there for its tooltip (a status you tap to read): a tap or a key press toggles it and a press outside closes it. Without it, a press on the trigger closes it and touch shows nothing, since the control has its own action
An empty content turns it off (a tooltip only for the icon-only form of a button)
Nothing interactive inside (links, buttons): that is a Popover
examples:
<Tooltip content="Restart PM">
  <button type="button" aria-label="Restart PM"><RotateCcw size={15} /></button>
</Tooltip>

// the trigger is there for its tooltip: tap or Enter toggles it
<Tooltip toggle content={<StageRows stage={s} />}>
  <button type="button" className="strip" aria-label="Stage: Building 2/4">...</button>
</Tooltip>

// only while the label is hidden
<Tooltip content={compact ? 'Restart PM' : ''}>...</Tooltip>
design: The board's stage tooltip: --color-surface-component (every status colour reads 4.5:1 on it in both modes; the elevated surface misses in dark), --elevation-3 with a 1px inset --color-border-subtle ring, --radius-lg corner
Text --type-size-2xs on --type-leading-normal in --color-text-faint, padding 0.625rem 0.75rem, width to fit up to min(18rem, 100vw - 1rem), left-aligned
Placed by Popover's anchorPopup: 6px below the trigger, start-aligned, flipped when the side is short, kept viewportMargin (8px) inside the window; kept in place while the page scrolls or resizes
Portalled to the body at z-index 60, Popover's layer, above Modal
Fades in with a 4px rise on recipe.quick and fades out on recipe.contentOut; Reduce Motion: the fade only
accessibility: role="tooltip"; the trigger gets aria-describedby naming it while open, beside any of its own
Opens on keyboard focus (:focus-visible) at once, not on a mouse click's focus; closes on blur
Escape closes it and is claimed (preventDefault, stopPropagation in the capture phase), so a Modal around it stays open; the next Escape is the Modal's
Never moves focus: it stays on the trigger
A press on the tooltip is stopped there, so it never reaches the trigger's ancestors (a card that opens on a press)

props.name: content
props.description: What it says: a line or a few rows, nothing interactive. Empty ('', null, false) turns it off.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger: one focusable element. Its ref and pointer, focus and click handlers are kept.

props.name: toggle
props.description: The trigger is there for its tooltip: a tap or a key press toggles it, a mouse click shows it at once, a press outside closes it.

props.name: delay
props.description: How long a mouse rests on the trigger before it opens, in ms.

props.name: placement
props.description: The preferred side; flips to the opposite one when it has no room.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap from the trigger, in px.

props.name: viewportMargin
props.description: Least distance from the window's edges, in px.
